supported_inputs: two or more perimeters, or one perimeter plus a positive constant rate_m_s
constant_rate_solver.initialization: Signed distance of the earliest perimeter. A single speed is the mean radial growth between the first and last observation, unless rate_m_s is prescribed.
constant_rate_solver.forecast_method: Isotropic Godunov level-set, phi_t + R |grad phi| = 0, with that one speed everywhere.
limitations: One number cannot represent spatial or directional rate variation.
The speed is clipped to [0.0001, 0.15] m/s when it is estimated.
No wind, fuel, or real-fire validation.

ray_inverse_solver.initialization: Angular bins around the mean of the earliest contour. Each bin stores the observed radial speed between consecutive perimeters.
ray_inverse_solver.forecast_method: Paint R(x, y) by interpolating those speeds in radius, extrapolate outside the swept annulus, then advance the isotropic Godunov solver.
limitations: This is a numerical hybrid, not a PINN and not a PDE-residual network.
R outside the annulus the front has already crossed is copied from the nearest measured radius on that ray.
The estimate assumes a single front that stays star-shaped around the initial contour mean.
No wind, fuel, or real-fire validation.

fourier_inverse_solver.initialization: Nelder-Mead on two coefficients of R = r0 * (1 + a * sin(kx) cos(ky)) at the prescribed 1500 m wavelength. Starts are the frozen Experiment 3 list. The kept start is the one with the smaller training-contour error.
fourier_inverse_solver.forecast_method: Isotropic Godunov level-set with the fitted field.
limitations: Specialized research option. The functional family and the wavelength are prescribed, not learned.
A start at zero amplitude can remain a constant field. The service also tries the frozen nonzero start and keeps the better training fit.
Do not use this model when the rate family is unknown.
The held-out forecast is not used to choose the start.
No wind, fuel, or real-fire validation.

direct_pinn_experimental.initialization: Hard initial condition Phi = phi0 / L + tau * g_theta on the analytical circle of radius 400 m centered at (200, -150) m. Domain [-2000, 2000]^2 m, L = 4000 m, T = 4000 s.
direct_pinn_experimental.forecast_method: Evaluate the Experiment 2A.3 F1 seed-0 Fourier PINN. Training used the known product rate inside the level-set residual. Inference does not estimate R.
limitations: Callable only on the benchmark it was trained on.
Seed 0 met the Experiment 2A.3 numeric targets. Seeds 1 and 2 did not, and they are not served.
The checkpoint does not accept a new perimeter, a new ignition, or a new rate field.
